name: Neural Skinning via Blend Weight Field
aliases: Novel Pose Synthesis via Neural Skinning
definition: A method to animate a learned template NeRF under novel human poses by updating the SMPL model parameters and computing a new neural blend weight field conditioned on a new latent code.
summary: Neural Skinning via Blend Weight Field animates NeRFs under novel poses by learning a residual neural blend weight field that corrects linear blend skinning for non-rigid deformations.
